tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__linkupapi_channel_list_network
tools.description:
LinkedIn & email outreach

Connections & invitations lookups on a connected channel (read-only; LinkedIn today). Pick an `action`:
- list_connections: { count?, offset? } — your connections (paginated, max 1000/call).
- list_invitations: { count?, offset?, invitation_type? } — received invitations.
- list_sent: { count?, offset?, invitation_type? } — invitations you sent.
- check_invitation: { profile_url } — connection status with that profile.
- recommendations: { count? } — people the channel recommends you connect with. This tool is part of plugin `LinkupAPI`.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__codex_apps__linkupapi_channel_list_network(args: { account_id: string; action: "list_connections" | "list_invitations" | "list_sent" | "check_invitation" | "recommendations"; params?: { [key: string]: unknown; }; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__linkupapi_channel_recruiter_read
tools.description:
LinkedIn & email outreach

Recruiter / jobs lookups on a connected channel (read-only, requires recruiter access; LinkedIn today). Pick an `action`:
- get_posts: { job_id?, count?, offset?, fetch_details? } — your posted jobs. Pass job_id to fetch one specific job.
- get_candidates: { job_id, count?, offset? } — applicants for a job.
- get_cv: { application_id } — download an applicant's CV (returned base64). This tool is part of plugin `LinkupAPI`.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__codex_apps__linkupapi_channel_recruiter_read(args: { account_id: string; action: "get_posts" | "get_candidates" | "get_cv"; params?: { [key: string]: unknown; }; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
